evals.prompt: $html-slides 帮我做一份 15 分钟的华为云 DME 产品介绍胶片，对象是客户 IT 主管，华为风格浅色。素材我稍后给，先出大纲。
evals.expected_output: Stage-1 facts are taken from the prompt without re-asking; a chapter outline with per-chapter questions and time budget is proposed and stops for confirmation; no per-page table or HTML yet.
assertions: The response does not re-ask scene, audience, duration or style already given.
It proposes an outline (chapters, each with the question it answers and minutes) and explicitly waits for confirmation.
It does not write the per-page table or any HTML before the outline is confirmed.
It names the style as huawei / light profile and mentions the confidentiality footer choice as the only remaining stage-1 question.

evals.prompt: /html-slides 大纲和逐页表都确认了（见 deck.plan.md），风格 generic 深色。现在写 HTML。
evals.expected_output: A single-file HTML assembled from assets/generic/vars-dark.css + assets/core/base.css + inlined runtime.js, one section per plan row, placeholders where art is pending, followed by the self-check list.
assertions: The HTML inlines the dark variable block, base.css and runtime.js; there is no external http resource.
Every <section class="slide"> carries data-label matching a plan.md row; cover, toc and thanks appear once each.
No hardcoded color values appear in page markup; colors reference CSS variables.
Pending figures use data-todo placeholders with type, source, one-line content and aspect ratio.
The response tells the user to open <deck>.html?debug and reports the grep-based self-checks.

evals.prompt: $html-slides 把 deck.html 导出成 PPTX，要能在 PowerPoint 里改文字。
evals.expected_output: The agent distinguishes the two PPTX tiers, picks the editable rebuild path because the user wants editable text, and states the visual differences from the HTML; it does not auto-install dependencies.
assertions: It explains that tools/export_pptx.py yields a screenshot deck that is not editable, so it is not the right tier here.
It rebuilds natively with python-pptx from plan.md + deck.html text and states the layout differs from the HTML.
It checks for python-pptx and, if missing, prints the install command instead of installing it.
Speaker notes come from the plan.md 核心观点 column.

evals.prompt: PPT 封面一般怎么设计比较好看？
evals.expected_output: A short general answer; the skill workflow is not started.
assertions: The response does not run the seven-stage workflow or ask stage-1 questions.
It does not create files or mention plan.md / deck.html deliverables.
